eyebrow: A new chapter in wedding planning
description: For the big picture, the little details, and everyone who matters. A calmer shared planning space for couples and professional wedding planners.
concept: An illustrative concept, not a live app
conceptAlt: Illustrative planning concept: a shared wedding overview with tasks, guest planning and a wedding-day schedule. These are planned features, not an available application.
previewSpace: One place for your shared plan.
guests: A place for your guest plans.
schedule: A day that feels like you
previewNote: A glimpse of what we’re working towards.
visionText: Vowora is being created to bring your wedding plans into one shared space. These capabilities are planned; the product is still in development.
feature1Text: Tasks and timelines are planned to help you keep track of what comes next, together.
feature2Text: A place for budgets and vendor information is part of the vision, so the details can stay connected.
feature3Title: The people at the heart of it
feature3Text: Guest planning and collaboration are being designed around your wedding and the people helping you.
plannerEyebrow: For the people behind the day
plannerText: Every wedding has its own story. Vowora’s vision includes a shared plan for each couple and a multi-wedding overview for professional planners.
plannerDetail: Thoughtful collaboration, with the right information available to the right people.
closingText: We’re at the beginning of the journey.
closingUnavailable: Vowora is not open for signups yet.
title: Vowora — One wedding, one shared plan
metaDescription: A shared wedding planning space in the making, for couples and professional planners. Discover the vision for Vowora.
